definitions.gloss: purity; purity level; degree of purity
definitions.explanation: The proportion of a substance that is pure, free from impurities or contamination. Used for metals, chemicals, water, and other substances.

examples.japanese: {純度|じゅんど}の{高|たか}い{金|きん}だ。
この{水|みず}は{純度|じゅんど}99%{以上|いじょう}だ。
examples.english: This water has a purity of over 99%.

examples.japanese: {半導体|はんどうたい}の{製造|せいぞう}には{極|きわ}めて{純度|じゅんど}の{高|たか}いシリコンが{必要|ひつよう}とされる。
examples.english: Extremely high-purity silicon is required for semiconductor manufacturing.

notes: Common collocations: {純度|じゅんど}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (high/low purity), {高|こう}{純度|じゅんど} (high purity — as a compound modifier). The suffix ～{度|ど} indicates degree or level, as in {濃度|のうど} (concentration), {精度|せいど} (precision), {鮮度|せんど} (freshness). Gold purity in Japan is expressed as {純度|じゅんど}: 24{金|きん} ({純金|じゅんきん}, pure gold), 18{金|きん} (75% purity). Related: {純粋|じゅんすい} (pure — used more broadly, including figuratively for people).
